name: Agentira Webhook Receiver
description: Receives Agentira webhook events and triggers agent runs — zero external dependencies

port.description: Port for the webhook HTTP server

token.description: Shared secret for X-Agentira-Token validation (empty = no auth)

gatewayToken.description: Bearer token for the gateway endpoint (supports ${VAR} interpolation)

agentName.description: Agent/model name passed to the gateway (blank = 'main')
